On 16th October 2025 over 120 female entrepreneurs attended the Midlands celebration of 
National Women’s Enterprise Day at Gloster House, Offaly. Hosted by the four Midlands LEOs 
of Longford, Laois, Offaly, and Westmeath, guest speakers included Anna-Marie Delaney, CE 
Offaly Co Co,  Dr. Anne Cusack, Gretchen Donovan, and Rebecca Lyons, who shared valuable 
insights to celebrate, support, and empower women in business, while also highlighting 
innovation, resilience, and the important role of female entrepreneurship in the region’s growth.  
Digital 26 event @ Google 
On Thursday, 13th November, a group of 18 creative and craft business owners and other Laois 
businesses travelled to Google HQ in Dublin to take part in Digital26: Craft & Creatives @ 
Google, a flagship event of the national Craft Work 4.0 initiative.  
 
The event was delivered in collaboration with Local Enterprise Offices in Carlow, Kildare, 
Kilkenny, Waterford, Wexford, and Wicklow and featured expert talks from Google, breakout 
sessions, and first-hand insights from creative businesses using digital tools including AI to grow 
and promote their work.

Driving Midlands Tech Forward: ICT Skills & R&D Collaboration 
The Midlands ICT Network recently hosted a workshop to unite the Skills & Talent and R&D

such as TuS, global multinationals, SMEs, and industry bodies, alongside educational agencies 
and local authorities. Our shared ambition is to strengthen collaboration, accelerate digital 
transformation, and drive innovation, positioning the Midlands as a premier destination to live, 
work, and invest.

Youthreach and “Flashback” 
A robots workshop was hosted by the SEO afterhours to Flashback, a youth club with Youth 
Reach that caters for teenage children with autism and neurodiverse needs. Along with their 
carers, these teens got to experience the world of robot engineering by building their own 
drivable robot under simple instruction sets and learning the concepts of coding and  
programming in an immersive and fun activity at their own pace. 
 
 
Kinia - A.I. and Hydrogen Power 
The SEO attended workshops with Kinia in smart A.I. and the positive use it can have in 
educational settings, from machine learning to gaming. Midlands Ireland has launched one of 
Kinia’s STEM programmes across Laois, Offaly, Westmeath and Longford with the H2GP Sprint 
and Pro programmes. The aim is to show the power of hydrogen in near-future technologies and 
energy generation. Mount Lucas in Offaly is a future site of hydrogen generation for Ireland’s 
H2 needs, and this programme will get students thinking about hydrogen’s future and where 
skills are needed in its development.

BROADBAND  
The NBI Fibre rollout in Laois has 13,000 premises included in the State’s Intervention Area, 
which will see NBI deliver minimum speeds of 500 megabits per second to homes, businesses, 
farms, and schools. As the biggest investment in rural Ireland since rural electrification, Co Laois 
has received €49M of Government investment under the National Broadband Plan.   
 
The rollout is progressing well with 11,978 homes, businesses, farms and schools now able to 
connect to high-speed fibre broadband, with 4,910 already connected.   Network construction 
is underway for the remaining premises (Portarlington and Templemore DA’s), with the 
connections expected to be completed by year end 2026.

School, Scoil Bhríde National School, Portlaoise Educate Together, Dunamase College,
